'''White Algae''' is an item which can be caught with a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] during all seasons at any underground location (Floors 20 & 60 of [[the Mines]], [[the Sewers]], the [[Mutant Bug Lair]], or the [[Witch's Swamp]]).

White Algae can also be dropped by several [[Monsters]]:  [[Grub]]s, [[Mutant Grub]]s, [[Cave Fly|Flies]], [[Mutant Fly|Mutant Flies]], [[Bug]]s, and Red, Purple, Copper, and Iron [[Slimes]].  A [[Ghostfish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 5 White Algae when the population of the pond reaches 9.

White Algae is displayed in the [[Collections#Fish|Fish section]] of the [[Collections|collection]] tab, and counts towards the four fishing [[Fishing#Achievements|Achievements]].<ref name="quasi_fish" /> However, it is otherwise not considered to be a fish, and therefore cannot be sold to [[Willy]] at the [[Fish Shop]], does not benefit from fish price bonuses, cannot be used in place of "Any Fish" in [[Cooking#Recipes|recipes]], and cannot be put in a [[Bait Maker]], [[Fish Smoker]], or [[Fish Pond]].

==Bundles==
Five White Algae are one of the options in the {{Bundle|Wild Medicine||y}}.

==Tailoring==
White Algae can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt248.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Collared Shirt]].

==Quests==
*Five White Algae are requested by [[Ghostfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*Five White Algae may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his third request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
